body:
Verified against the actual shared catalog parser: it counts open objects/arrays with the root included. The fixture opens five base containers plus two per `allOf` wrapper. The test now derives 61 as its deepest accepted member (127 containers) and exercises the next member, 62 (129), against the unchanged shared cap of 128. Each accepted TypeScript/GraphQL/Pydantic production call must emit both definitions; all three must return the shared JSON nesting-limit error for 62. The original deeper refusal is also retained.

Actual validation passed: strict affected-target Clippy (`cargo clippy --locked -p purrdf-shapes --test large_schema_emission -- -D warnings`) and the entire original `large_schema_emission` target, all five tests including the strengthened boundary and original width/coverage controls. No production guard or acceptance assertion was weakened.
